snippet.title: Escape from 8 Bit High Release Trailer
snippet.description:
When a cursed cassette awakens a sentient Pomodore 64, Cloudydale High is overrun by 8-bit villains! Join alt-rock trio Blueberry Finn—Hank, Duck, and Alex—as they battle mole men, aliens, dinosaurs and more in a bizarre, musical quest to save the world!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2761220/Escape_from_8Bit_High/

GOG:
https://www.gog.com/en/game/escape_from_8bit_high
